item.title: Volunteering Experience
item.description: A couple of months back , I helped out to organize clinical examination for RACP. I created a tool ( Excel Macro) for finalizing exam schedules for all attendees. The roster should consider employee preference, examiner availability, timeslot, venue and other parameters. Below is what I got in return ( even though they misspelled my name).
